hypotheses.justification: The existing proof works unchanged: ha2 is never used, and ModularCurve.C4b.core has no corresponding assumption. Thus the proof covers arbitrary a satisfying the remaining hypotheses.

Split on whether the reduction is zero. In the nonzero case, use the existing proof. In the zero case, Subtype.ext identifies the element in the conclusion with zero, and AlgebraicCurve.Place.ord_zero proves the result. This lemma is established in Definitions/Def_AlgebraicCurve_DivisorClassGroup.lean; ord assigns zero to zero.
